renders.title: HEALING, SHARED
renders.lead: No single healer has to carry the party. Recovery and stress relief are spread across the roster.
items: Crusader · Battle Heal
Heals 3–4 (6–7 at level 5) and hardens the target's armor.
Arbalest · Bandage & Rallying Flare
The bandage cures bleed; the flare relieves 3–5 stress for the whole party.
Antiquarian · Fortifying Vapours
Amplifies every heal the target receives, +20–40%, stacking.
Man-at-Arms · Bolster
A repeatable party stress heal that steadies the line.

renders.title: BREAK THE ARMOR
renders.lead: Support opens armored enemies, and physical attackers finish what it starts.
items: Occultist · Weakening Curse
Enemy PROT −25 to −35% for 3 turns.
Shieldbreaker · Puncture
Pierces guard and cuts PROT by 30–40%.
Leper · Sunder
The fallen king leads the charge: PROT −30 to −50% on the front rank.
Vestal · Illumination
Strips dodge and armor and reveals the hidden, from any rank.

renders.title: ANOTHER WAY TO PLAY
renders.lead: Familiar heroes gain new ranks, roles and reasons to bring a different fourth skill.
items: Highwayman · Tracking Shot
Readies a riposte without stepping forward.
Jester · Solo & Inspiring Tune
Solo from any rank, Inspiring Tune from rank 2.
Vestal · Mace Bash
A front-rank Vestal can now heal herself as she fights.
Abomination · Transform
Stress he keeps in check with Absolution becomes the beast's firepower.

renders.title: REFINED, NOT REINVENTED
renders.lead: Every change is tuned inside the original game's own rules, so it never feels foreign.
items: The same tension
Every buff carries a price. The game stays as hard as you remember.
Clear guardrails
Class trinkets and each hero's official lore set the limits of every change.
Evidence, not instinct
Game data, a comparison model and real play decide the numbers.
Built with players
Every comment is read, and every change keeps a written reason.

renders.tagline: She never tires. Now neither does her kit.
rows: Her strongest swings exhausted her, at odds with a warrior whose lore says she never tires.
A relentless front-line berserker who wins through pressure.
Breakthrough and Bleed Out no longer exhaust her. Adrenaline Rush now heals 3–7 instead of boosting her attacks.
Barbaric YAWP! has no use limit and weakens every enemy: shout, heal herself and keep swinging.
Transforming dumped stress on every ally, so the beast often stayed in its chains.
A cursed outsider: controlled in human form, explosive as the beast.
He carries the cost himself: self stress +12, allies only +5. Transforming heals 8–12 and the beast gains CRIT +6–10%.
Keep your stress in check with Absolution, then spend it to unleash the beast.

renders.title: UPDATE 2.5.9
renders.subtitle: The Antiquarian earns her place, and support skills reach further.
items: Antiquarian rework: weak until Champion, then her class trinkets lift the whole party.
Crusader's Battle Heal now also raises the target's PROT.
Arbalest's Rallying Flare relieves 3–5 stress for the party.
Duelist and Runaway play as vanilla while their changes are being tested.

renders.quote: Every hero deserves a reason to join the party.
